title: Preflight groups repeated failures, names the provider and puts the fix beside them
acceptance: Tracks that fail for the same reason and provider show as one group with a count, not one row each.
A no-connected-provider failure names the provider the tracks are linked to.
The fix action (connect or reconnect that provider, or Manage connections) sits with the group, not after the full list.
Run without music and the honest Blocked verdict are unchanged.

evidence.summary: PreflightGroup renders one row per track; Manage connections renders after both lists; the no_connected_provider label carries no provider. Checked on main c9b89a7.
2026-10-28 owner UX audit of production: Top priority 11 and the Live preflight rows. Browser evidence; not re-observed at intake.
Work PR for this task; opened as a draft claim on 2026-11-13. Records the PR, not a merge.

Pure grouping and wording: one group per reason and provider, class order, provider named, singular and plural hints. Passed locally on the PR branch, with LivePreflight.test.tsx (group count, provider name, Manage connections inside the group, Blocked and Run without music unchanged), coordinator.test.ts (providers carried, reasons unchanged) and Dialog.test.tsx (focus fallback).

Before and after renders of the blocked preflight at 1440 and 390 wide, in this folder. LivePreflight rendered alone with fixture tracks through the Vite dev server, not the signed-in app; ready, loading and error renders were byte-identical before and after and are not stored.

resolution: Live preflight now shows failing tracks as one group per reason and provider, with a track count; a no-connection group names the linked provider (for example "Apple Music is not connected"); connection-fixable groups carry Manage connections themselves, and the standalone button stays only when no group has one. The unplayable selection carries display-only `providers`; provider selection, the reason, clip math and runtime are unchanged. Start basis, a flagged judgment call: the owner approved the web priority order in DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md "Now" on 2026-11-13, and the conducting session took the owner’s "what can we complete while I’m away" as the go-ahead to start this task; it was never in Ready. Judgment calls: the group action is Manage connections (the acceptance allows it) because a direct per-provider connect button needs LiveMode.tsx, which was out of scope; the dialog primitive returns focus to a marked fallback when a fix removes the group that opened it. Not verified: the grouped screen against real Apple Music and Spotify connections in a browser (jsdom tests and a component render with fixtures only). Owner-gated (playback code): the PR needs owner-approved.
